name: Hans-Peter Meier
bio:
Hans-Peter Meier brings a wealth of financial expertise to Iron Dames, honed over two decades in corporate finance. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, he transitioned from traditional banking to pursue his passion, believing that sound financial strategy is as crucial as horsepower on the track. Hans-Peter emphasizes transparency and data-driven decision-making, ensuring the team's resources are optimally allocated. 

His unique approach involves leveraging innovative financial models to identify untapped revenue streams and cost-saving opportunities. Known for his meticulous attention to detail and forward-thinking strategies, Hans-Peter is a key asset in securing Iron Dames' long-term financial stability and competitive edge. He thrives on the fast-paced environment of motorsport and the challenge of balancing ambition with fiscal responsibility.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: A man of medium height with a sturdy build, he often wears tailored suits.

quirks: Always carries a vintage slide rule for quick calculations, despite using modern software.
Insists on using fountain pens for all official documents.
Humming classical music while reviewing financial reports
